senses.gloss: m. (פשר) division, space between, alternative, whence possibility; it is possible.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 14:14">Targ. Job XIV, 14</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 11b:10">Ḥull. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>היכא דא׳ א׳</he> where it is possible (to ascertain facts), it is possible (we must do), but where it is impossible &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 61b:18">Yeb. 61ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>אין דנין א׳ משאי א׳</he> we cannot form an analogy between a case where there is an alternative and one where there is none.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:18">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>לא א׳ ליה</he> he has no means.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:4:2">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אי א׳ לומר</he> you cannot say.
<cite ref="Taanit 3b:2">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>אי א׳ לעולם וכ׳</he> the world cannot exist without &c.; a. fr.
